lines: Middle too is threefold by desire-pronouncement: when desire leads, mildness — by Lord-mantra-yoga means, since desire there, since that yoga's end is release — hence its descent-nature.
l4.sanskrit_cite: madhyas tu tridhā bhogotsukatā yadā pradhānabhūtā tadā mandatvaṃ pārameśvaramantrayogopāyatayā yatas tatra autsukyam pārameśamantrayogādeś ca yato mokṣaparyantatvam ataḥ śaktipātarūpatā
